title: Inspection Wait Credit — Returns & Exchanges
content:
When the Marlowe & Finch returns centre is slow to post an inspection, the customer receives an inspection-wait credit against any charge for spent instant store credit on that Returns & Exchanges return. The wait is the calendar days from the date the returns centre received the parcel to the date it posted the inspection.

## Inspection-wait credit

| Calendar days from receipt to posted inspection | Credit taken off the amount charged to the original card |
|---|---|
| More than 14 | 10.00 USD |
| More than 7, up to 14 | 5.00 USD |
| 7 or fewer | Nothing |

The amount charged to the original card is never below zero, and it is rounded half up to the cent.

## Both sides of each threshold

| Days | Credit |
|---|---|
| 7 | Nothing |
| 8 | 5.00 |
| 14 | 5.00 |
| 15 | 10.00 |

The received date and the inspected date are read from the return.

Example (hypothetical): a parcel received on 2 May and inspected on 12 May waited 10 days, so 5.00 is taken off; an amount of 34.80 becomes 29.80.
